title: Unique Silky Irish White Beans Casserole
description: A mustardy, silky, date-night Irish dish featuring dried white beans, lamination-puff, and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch

In a large bowl, combine the soaked and drained white beans, whole wheat flour, unsalted butter, Dijon mustard, chopped fresh parsley, grated cheddar cheese, low-fat milk, salt, and black pepper, and mix well
Spoon the bean mixture onto one half of the puff pastry, leaving a 1/2 inch border around the edges
Brush the edges of the puff pastry with a little water
Fold the other half of the puff pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal
Use a knife to cut a few slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape
Place the casserole on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 35 minutes
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving
